lead.headline: DEEPSEEK-HARNESS SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: DeepSeek Harness is revolutionizing software development with its innovative plugin-based architecture
lead.body: In a stunning display of growth, DeepSeek Harness has become the fastest-growing repository on GitHub, with a staggering 98,010 stars and an astonishing 31,314 new followers in just one day. This meteoric rise can be attributed to the project's bold vision of making everything a plugin, allowing developers to seamlessly integrate and customize various tools and services. By abstracting the complexities of software development, DeepSeek Harness is empowering developers to focus on building and innovating, rather than wrestling with tedious integrations and compatibility issues. As a result, the project is attracting a vast and diverse community of developers who are eager to explore its potential and contribute to its growth
